remarks:
Welcome to this incredibly unique, versatile property situated on a generous 1.6-acre lot in the highly desirable Starpoint School District! Offering a perfect blend of comfortable residential living, outdoor recreation, and unmatched utility, this property is truly a rare find.

Inside, the home features a warm and inviting layout accented by gorgeous cherry hardwood floors flowing through the kitchen, living room, and upstairs bathroom. The current floor plan offers 2 spacious bedrooms on the second floor—with excellent potential to easily configure a 3rd bedroom—and 1.5 baths, including a highly convenient first-floor laundry room. The primary suite boasts an exceptionally large closet, as well as a large walkout deck to enjoy views of the pool and property. Major mechanical and structural updates provide ultimate peace of mind, including brand-new windows throughout (2025), a new hot water tank (2025), a sump pump equipped with a water backup system, and a roof that is approximately 5 years young.

Step outside into your private outdoor oasis, complete with a beautiful above-ground pool surrounded by spacious decking, and a peaceful koi pond.

For hobbyists, collectors, or entrepreneurs, the crowning jewel of this property is the outstanding workspace: two massive detached garages offering premier capacity. This setup is perfect for an automotive enthusiast, landscaping storage, hobby workshop, or specialized equipment. With town approval, these expansive structures offer incredible potential for a future business. Don't miss out on this one-of-a-kind property!
